propositions: CodeHealthConfig.analyzers field is never read in production, only written by config plumbing and monkeypatched by tests

The per-language analyzer dispatch (ANALYZERS registry, resolve_analyzer, analyze_or_unavailable) was designed in epic 839b but intentionally shipped empty and never wired; story c23c already mandated its removal conditional on no usage
The dispatch is unviable: analyze_or_unavailable calls analyzer.analyze(languages=languages) by keyword but scc_loc.analyze names its second parameter scan_roots, causing TypeError at runtime
Deletion targets include ANALYZERS, resolve_analyzer, analyze_or_unavailable, load_lizard, CodeHealthConfig.analyzers field and coercion row, and the read-via escape marker
AnalyzerResult protocol and Analyzer protocol must be retained; the live composition path in git_metrics.py (_scc_analysis, _lizard_analysis, _jscpd_analysis, _cached_analysis) is unaffected
Removal requires a tombstone registry entry for the config key to prevent silent drops and warn existing users
